D/ CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ VIRTVS [EXE]RCIT In

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus. Constantine I (306-337). Issue of 320-321, Reece Period 16, probably Trier Mint. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS AVG Reverse description: Two captives seated at foot of standard. Reverse inscription: VIRTVS [EXE]RCIT In exergue: possibly PTR; T left of standard. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
